resources.string:
Nourishing uses your signed-in cloud account. Your PC and Tailscale are not required. The app shares its secure first-party sign-in session with foreground Health Connect imports. Session secrets are not exposed to JavaScript or copied into app preferences.

Health Connect reads only the data types you select and approve. Reads cover at most 30 recent calendar days. A complete export is staged in app-private cache. It includes measurements, source app names, source record IDs, modification times, interval timestamps, and any recorded exercise, sleep, glucose, blood pressure or temperature context.

Preview uploads the selected export to your account for review. Confirm imports the reviewed records into that same account. Imports add or update records; absent records are not deleted. You can save the export as a local JSON file instead. You can revoke Health Connect permissions at any time.

This cloud build does not enable background health sync, writes to Health Connect, reconciliation, home widgets, Wear relay or native reminders. Previous native write journals and receipts remain stored under their original connection and are not reassigned when you sign in to another account.

Camera and file access are used only when you choose those features. Downloaded exports stay private until you save or share them. The app does not back up its private files through Android backup.
